Leah (CEO): Hi team — quick heads up: All-hands this Friday 10:00 AM PT (Zoom link https://zoom.redwood.ai/ah). Agenda below. Please drop 1-line Qs in this thread by Thursday EOD. Recording will be shared after.

Priya (Head of Product): Agenda:
- 10:00 Opening + strategy highlights (Leah)
- 10:10 Product roadmap callouts (Priya)
- 10:25 Dedicated + Private rollout timeline (Marco)
- 10:35 Reliability & incident review (Sam)
- 10:50 Q&A
Please add any items that need a short slot.

Marco (Infra): Quick ask — I'll cover Dedicated SLA changes; if you have customer-impact examples DM me.

Sam (SRE): Can we include the May 18 outage postmortem summary? will take 3 mins.

Asha (People Ops): Note: hybrid office watch party at 9:45 for those local :coffee:

DevOps Bot: Reminder: calendar invite created and RSVP open.

Evan (IC): I have a question about rollback policy for model rollouts — dropping here: How automatic are rollbacks on regression alerts?

Leah (CEO): Good Q Evan — we'll cover rollback basics, and Priya will follow up with docs.

Priya (Head of Product): Also linking the pre-read for the roadmap: https://docs.redwood.ai/pre-reads/ah-may - skim sections 1-3.

Jordan (Sales): Could we get a short note about pricing changes for Dedicated customers? even a 1-slide note.

Leah (CEO): Jordan — yes, pricing callout will be 1 slide. Thanks.

(Friday 11:15 AM PT) Leah (CEO): Thanks all — recording live now: https://s3.redwood.ai/recordings/2034567890-allhands.mp4

Priya (Head of Product): Post-meeting takeaways:
- Shipping: 2-week cadence for minor releases, canary first then blue/green
- Dedicated: SLA bumped to 99.95% for reserved pools, rollout starts June A
- Reliability: May 18 outage root cause was autoscaling race in the scheduler; mitigations deployed
- Action: eng-runtime to add a regression eval to pre-release checklist (owner: Marco)

Marco (Infra): Added JIRA ENG-4227 for rollout automation; assigned to @Marco.

Sam (SRE): Postmortem link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/may18-postmortem

Asha (People Ops): Thanks for the hybrid watch party turnout :raised_hands: — recording and slides in calendar.

Evan (IC): Nice session. Can someone post the slide deck?

Priya (Head of Product): Deck attached: https://drive.redwood.ai/Slides/2034567890-allhands-deck.pdf

Leah (CEO): Final note: if you had a question that wasn't answered, please add it here or ping your manager. We'll follow up in next week syncs. :sparkles:

DevOps Bot: Meeting closed — summary posted.
